name: Pose-Aware Projection (PAP)
definition: A technique to extract multi-view contextual information for selected voxels by projecting skeletal Gaussian positions onto 2D feature maps and aggregating features based on camera distance, resolving ambiguous feature assignment from global backprojection.
summary: Pose-Aware Projection aggregates multi-view features for selected voxels using inverse distance weighting, avoiding the occlusion errors of global backprojection.
